newsitem.title: CHINA: Risk control to be key task for China - official.
newsitem.headline: Risk control to be key task for China - official.

text.p: Risk control will be a top priority for China's central bank, the People's Bank of China, in 1997, its deputy governor, Chen Yuan, was quoted as saying in official media on Thursday.
"Risk control is the year's most important financial supervisory task," Shanghai Securities News quoted Chen as telling a recent meeting of finance officials.

Bad loans, rampant financial crime and irregularities posed risks to China's financial markets, he said. As China became more integrated with the world market, it was also exposed to international risks, he said.
Chinese officials have alluded to the Mexican currency crisis as a problem they wish to avoid in the course of developing domestic financial markets.

In 1996, the central bank cracked down on financial irregularities and institutions to control risk, and either closed or sold three major trust investment companies, the China Securities News also reported Chen as saying.
